description: Fail CI if the scout±confirm path regresses vs the frozen snapshot, or if the production-like oracle mock loses labeled-ad recall.
notes: Recall/hit/F1/FN/residual are absolute (e.g. 0.02 = 2 percentage points). Token-count rise is relative (0.10 = +10%). Token reduction is in percentage points vs the snapshot mean_token_reduction_pct. Default CI uses mocks; live Gemini is never required.
